issues.on_page: Loss on disposition of capital assets 50.00 (positive, inside Total nonoperating revenues 59.37)
issues.issue: The line is labelled a loss but printed as a positive revenue. The cash flow statement (p3) shows 50.00 of proceeds from the sale of capital assets. Recording it as a sale of assets receipt is defensible, and the line already carries a review flag.

issues.extracted: debt - due in more than one year
issues.issue: Compensated absences are not debt. The current portion is coded accrued liabilities. Other liabilities or accrued liabilities would be more consistent.
The extractor added '(current)' to the printed label. The line sits under CURRENT LIABILITIES, so the meaning is right, but the label is not exactly as printed.
